raw: [Subtitle(text="I came from an ordinary family in Kreis Einwald. I should not have been able to become a noble's attendant, but I heard that Herkunftshorn made no distinction between nobles and commoners.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: I came from an ordinary family in Kreis Einwald. I should not have been able to become a noble's attendant, but I heard that Herkunftshorn made no distinction between nobles and commoners.

raw: [Subtitle(text="This was not because he treated commoners particularly well, but because he looked down equally on all who cowered at the foot of his throne.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: This was not because he treated commoners particularly well, but because he looked down equally on all who cowered at the foot of his throne.

raw: [Subtitle(text="At first, my job was to clean his instruments. But Herkunftshorn no longer played ordinary music, and those instruments had no meaning.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: At first, my job was to clean his instruments. But Herkunftshorn no longer played ordinary music, and those instruments had no meaning.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Later, I was sent to clean the resonance pipelines at the top of the Spire. It was not a difficult job, but Herkunftshorn would not tolerate even a single speck of dust in them.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Later, I was sent to clean the resonance pipelines at the top of the Spire. It was not a difficult job, but Herkunftshorn would not tolerate even a single speck of dust in them.

raw: [Subtitle(text="My colleagues came and went. Few got to leave on their own two feet. In the end, I was the only one left, quietly cleaning at the top of the tower.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: My colleagues came and went. Few got to leave on their own two feet. In the end, I was the only one left, quietly cleaning at the top of the tower.

raw: [Subtitle(text="And a thousand sunrises and sunsets later, the Witch King's Spire fell.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: And a thousand sunrises and sunsets later, the Witch King's Spire fell.

speaker: Imperial Caster
content: How did we... lose to you?

raw: [name="Arturia"]Normally I wouldn't stand a chance, but your souls have become stiff and inflexible due to the bindings of the Güldenesgesatz, creating innumerable weaknesses in your Arts.
speaker: Arturia
content: Normally I wouldn't stand a chance, but your souls have become stiff and inflexible due to the bindings of the Güldenesgesatz, creating innumerable weaknesses in your Arts.

raw: [name="Imperial Caster"]But... why? With Arts like these, you could have changed your destiny, enjoyed wealth, fame, and favor beyond reckoning... What meaning is there in defying the Kaiserinnen?

content: But... why? With Arts like these, you could have changed your destiny, enjoyed wealth, fame, and favor beyond reckoning... What meaning is there in defying the Kaiserinnen?

raw: [name="Arturia"]Hm, I think we have very different views on the meaning of meaning.
speaker: Arturia
content: Hm, I think we have very different views on the meaning of meaning.

raw: [name="Arturia"]Fame, fortune, status... All merely accessories to a soul that will eventually wither and rot with the passage of time.
speaker: Arturia
content: Fame, fortune, status... All merely accessories to a soul that will eventually wither and rot with the passage of time.

raw: [name="Arturia"]Kurfürst, beggar, or myself, the only difference is in the whispers of our hearts.
speaker: Arturia
content: Kurfürst, beggar, or myself, the only difference is in the whispers of our hearts.

raw: [name="Arturia"]I want to climb the tallest spire. Because of a melody, a soul, and a future.
speaker: Arturia
content: I want to climb the tallest spire. Because of a melody, a soul, and a future.

raw: [name="Arturia"]And for a promise I made to a friend.
speaker: Arturia
content: And for a promise I made to a friend.

text: Ten years had passed since the death of the Witch King. I was attending the funeral of an old friend.

raw: [Subtitle(text="After the funeral, I saw a Sankta with her cello in the amphitheater below the Twin Spires. Others came and went, but she stood there from noon until sundown.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: After the funeral, I saw a Sankta with her cello in the amphitheater below the Twin Spires. Others came and went, but she stood there from noon until sundown.

raw: [name="Arturia"]According to legend, even the clouds stopped for the Witch King when he played up on his spire.
speaker: Arturia
content: According to legend, even the clouds stopped for the Witch King when he played up on his spire.

raw: [name="Arturia"]I wonder... do the clouds remember what the Spire looked like back then?
speaker: Arturia
content: I wonder... do the clouds remember what the Spire looked like back then?

raw: [Subtitle(text="I suppose not. Clouds change so quickly, after all.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: I suppose not. Clouds change so quickly, after all.

raw: [name="Arturia"]My teacher often told me of how he stood beneath the Witch King's Spire while it was still standing, playing for the sole sovereign of Leithanien.
speaker: Arturia
content: My teacher often told me of how he stood beneath the Witch King's Spire while it was still standing, playing for the sole sovereign of Leithanien.

raw: [name="Arturia"]The golden-red clouds embraced the dark spire like an extravagant robe.
speaker: Arturia
content: The golden-red clouds embraced the dark spire like an extravagant robe.

raw: [name="Arturia"]He wanted to come back and see the spectacle again, but wasn't allowed to participate in Das Kaiserinnensfest. In fact, he could barely get permission to leave his home.
speaker: Arturia
content: He wanted to come back and see the spectacle again, but wasn't allowed to participate in Das Kaiserinnensfest. In fact, he could barely get permission to leave his home.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Herr Emmanuel was one of the Witch King's musicians, after all, even if just for a short while. Times were hard for him after the Witch King's demise.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Herr Emmanuel was one of the Witch King's musicians, after all, even if just for a short while. Times were hard for him after the Witch King's demise.

raw: [name="Arturia"]Few came to say their goodbyes, and you were the only one to truly shed tears for him.
speaker: Arturia
content: Few came to say their goodbyes, and you were the only one to truly shed tears for him.

text: I heard your playing at the funeral. It was very touching.

speaker: Arturia
content: Danke.

raw: [name="Arturia"]But that doesn't bring even the slightly bit of comfort to my teacher.
speaker: Arturia
content: But that doesn't bring even the slightly bit of comfort to my teacher.

raw: [name="Arturia"]I asked to play for him while he was still alive, but he refused. During his days of pain and hardship, he refused to dwell on the happiness of the past, nor did he seek any change.
speaker: Arturia
content: I asked to play for him while he was still alive, but he refused. During his days of pain and hardship, he refused to dwell on the happiness of the past, nor did he seek any change.

raw: [name="Arturia"]He simply shut himself in his room, playing the Güldenesgesatz over and over again.
speaker: Arturia
content: He simply shut himself in his room, playing the Güldenesgesatz over and over again.

raw: [name="Arturia"]Through that unchanging melody, he drowned himself in Leithanien's greatness. Forgetting love, forgetting hate, and forgetting himself.
speaker: Arturia
content: Through that unchanging melody, he drowned himself in Leithanien's greatness. Forgetting love, forgetting hate, and forgetting himself.

raw: [name="Arturia"]Yet, when faced with death, his heart was still filled with... regret.

content: Yet, when faced with death, his heart was still filled with... regret.

raw: [Subtitle(text="I thought that, going from Vedunien to Zwillingstürme, from the Witch King's Spire to the Twin Empresses' Spires, the melody echoing in the dusk would be somehow different.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: I thought that, going from Vedunien to Zwillingstürme, from the Witch King's Spire to the Twin Empresses' Spires, the melody echoing in the dusk would be somehow different.
